data.name: Panic Room 2: Hide and Seek
data.detailed_description:
Your journey to an abandoned mansion turned into a trap. The thirst for profit led you straight into the clutches of a psychopathic maniac — into a place soaked in the fear and hopelessness of its previous victims. Forget about treasure; now your only goal is to survive. And maybe, just maybe, uncover the identity of whoever is hiding behind the Puppeteer’s mask this time.

From the first minutes, you’ll be immersed in a gripping detective story, the terrifying atmosphere of a mystical thriller, realistic graphics, and enchanting music. Diverse gameplay, numerous quests, clever puzzles, and riddles will surely pull you deep into this universe.

In the game, you will find:

  • Puzzles, collections, and jigsaws — the full set of the hidden object genre.

  • Many game locations and hidden object modes.

  • Additional game mechanics that make the gameplay truly dynamic.

  • Social features that let you help and send gifts to your friends.

One main question remains: what misdeeds has fate brought you here to answer for?
